entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for a helmet. Order number 91-Kilo-45.

Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up that order... 91-Kilo-45. I see the Velo-Guard helmet delivered 14 days ago. To get this processed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue?
Look, there's no issue. I just don't want it. The color isn't what I expected. Can I return it or not? It's a simple question.
I understand. I just have to confirm a few details. Is it a technical fault or just a preference?
Preference. I just said, it's the color. The box is still unopened. I'm sure its safety features are fine, I just don't need this helmet. Yes or no, can I send it back?
Yes, absolutely. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. Okay, I see it was delivered 14 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy.
Good. So what's next? Are you sending a label?

Correct. I've just processed the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just print that out and attach it to the original box.
Okay, I just got the email. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Was there anything else for you today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
